notes: Staged the 109 unique archival main-track paper identities exposed by the official accepted-paper table and reconciled them one-to-one with the detailed program: 85 Research Papers and 24 Experience Papers.

The accepted-paper page states that 110 papers were accepted but enumerates only 109 unique title-and-author rows; the omitted paper identity is unresolved, so collection_status is PARTIAL and no record was invented.
Proceedings, official paper pages, abstracts, DOI metadata, and paper PDFs were not available from the checked official conference sources.
The non-main program audit found two Best of CCR paper placeholders, zero SIGCOMM Shorts, and one sponsored Meta session; these are excluded from the 109 main-track count and have no paper bundles.
The counts.excluded field is the relevance-excluded main-track count (zero), not the separate non-main program audit count.
